name: Psychology
blurb: The science of mind and behaviour. Choose a BPS-accredited course to keep the route to Chartered Psychologist open.

name: Biology
blurb: Living things from molecules to ecosystems, with lots of lab and field work.

name: Biomedical Science
blurb: The biology of human health and disease. IBMS accreditation matters if NHS lab work is a goal.

name: Biochemistry
blurb: Where chemistry meets biology: the molecules and reactions that keep cells alive.

name: Pharmaceutical Science
blurb: How medicines are discovered, made and tested. Leads to industry and lab careers rather than being a pharmacist.

name: Pharmacy
blurb: A 4-year MPharm, then a foundation training year, to register as a pharmacist.

name: Natural Sciences
blurb: One flexible degree where you build your own mix of sciences. Most courses ask for A*AA or A-level Maths, so only these two fit your grades and subjects.

name: Speech & Language Therapy
blurb: Helping people with communication and swallowing difficulties. Uses psychology and biology, with NHS placements.
